_meta.notes: MIXED DECIMAL SEPARATORS - the filer uses a COMMA for the cents on some lines and a period on others, and this is recorded exactly as written: Line 1 Column A '2,404,17', Line 2 Column B '17484,50' and Line 7 '496,18' all use a decimal COMMA, while Lines 2A ('3043.29'), 3 ('1,135.30'), 5 ('3,539.47') and 1B ('18,903.46') use a period. Line 4 restates Line 1 as '2,404.17' with a period. Thousands commas are omitted on Lines 2 Column A and 2 Column B. Neither amendment box is checked; the older form variant's top-row 'Office' box is blank. Arithmetic consistent once the commas are read as decimal points (1,135.30 + 2,404.17 = 3,539.47; minus 3,043.29 = 496.18).
